snippet.title: DETRA Trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer for "DETRA". Made by Steel Coffin. 

DETRA is a story-rich supernatural horror game where you follow the story of Vir and Druxy, a scientist couple who delve into an abandoned laboratory, in search of a cure for an illness that Druxy has got. Follow along as the trip ends up revealing more about their relationship than was intended. 

Play now on itchio! 
unamort.itch.io/detra
Steam release coming early Summer 2025. 

#game #indiegame #indiegamedev #horrorgame #storyrichgames #supernaturalhorror
